newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed on late bull spreading.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed on late bull spreading.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed on late commission house buying that set off a wave of bull-spreading, traders said.
"Refco came in and bought close to 2.5 million Dec late. We blew through stops at around $4.35 (in KCBT Dec), and the spread just kept on widening," a trader said.
The Dec/March spread was offered as wide as 16-1/2 cents at one point in the session's closing minutes.
KCBT wheat had been pressured at the midsession by continued good planting conditions in the central U.S. High Plains and by weakness in CBOT soybeans, traders said.
KCBT wheat closed 6-1/2 cents per bushel lower to two cents higher, with Dec up two cents at $4.34-1/2. March gained 1/2 cent to close at $4.21.
Other major players included Wolcott & Lincoln, which bought 2.3 million March. CIS bought 1.4 million Dec and 2.1 million March and sold two million Dec. LFG sold one million March, traders said.
The KCBT estimated Friday's wheat futures volume at 30.840 million bushels, versus 31.370 million on Thursday.
